# Claude Agent Copilot Instructions

This workspace is configured to use Claude Agent as an AI assistant for development tasks. Claude provides intelligent code generation, debugging, testing, and architectural guidance with extended reasoning capabilities.

## Workspace Configuration

- Claude Agent is enabled for enhanced AI assistance
- Use this workspace for coding projects, development, and technical problem-solving
- All AI interactions use Claude Agent by default

## How to Use

1. Open the Copilot Chat panel (`Ctrl+Shift+I` or `Cmd+Shift+I`)
2. Ask Claude questions about your code or development tasks
3. Use `@workspace` to reference workspace context
4. Request code generation, refactoring, debugging, or architecture help

## Customization

Modify this file to add project-specific instructions or coding standards that Claude should follow.
